newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissho Iwai shares rise on bright forecast.
newsitem.headline: Nissho Iwai shares rise on bright forecast.

text.p: Shares of Nissho Iwai Corp, a major trading house, continued to rise in heavy trade on Thursday morning, as the firm's bright earnings forecast kept attracting investors, traders said.
By 0025 GMT, the shares had gained five yen to trade at 485. Nissho's turnover of 2.685 million shares was the second heaviest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
On Tuesday, Nissho Iwai said it expects its parent current profits to increase to 35 billion yen from actual profits of 22.32 billion yen the previous year.
